chunks: And from him (al-Shaykh) from Fadala from Husayn from Ibn Muskhan from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who stands in the row behind the Imam, and there is no one on his left; how should he give the salam? He said: 'Give one salam to his right.'

key_terms.الصَّفِّ: The row of worshippers in prayer
key_terms.تَسْلِيمَةً: A single salam (greeting of peace concluding prayer)

ai.seo_question: How should a person standing directly behind the Imam perform the final salam in prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of congregational prayer arrangements, specifically addressing the practical issue of asymmetry when a worshipper stands directly behind the Imam with no companion on his left. It establishes the precedent for offering a single salam to the right in such cases, reflecting the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence to maintain prayer validity despite minor deviations from the ideal symmetrical formation. This ruling underscores the importance of following the Imam's lead while adapting to the physical realities of the congregation.
